title: agent-workflow-kit project config
description: Per-project rules for the kit's hooks. Lives at .claude/agent-workflow.json. Commands for building and testing live in AGENTS.md, not here.

stack.description: The stack pack this config started from, for humans and the /inspect skill.

protected.description: Files Claude must not edit. The first matching rule wins.

reason.description: Shown to Claude when an edit is blocked. Say what to do instead.

allowCreate.description: Allow writing a new matching file (for example a new migration) while blocking edits to existing ones.

formatOnEdit.description: Formatter to run after Claude edits a matching file. The first matching rule wins.

command.description: Run from the project root. {file} is replaced with the edited file's path.

pairedFiles.description: Reminders handed to Claude after it edits a matching file.

patterns.description: Text an edit must not add. Only the added text is checked, so existing code doesn't trigger it. Claude gets the message as a reminder.

regex.description: Python regular expression, searched line by line in the added text.

message.description: What rule this breaks and what to write instead.

glob.description: Root-relative glob. `**/` spans directories; `*` and `?` stay within one.
